sources.title: Federal Decree by Law No. (45) of 2021 Concerning the Protection of Personal Data
sources.notes: Official English translation on the UAE legislation portal (direct fetch 403; via Jina). Date is entry into force (Art 31). Applies onshore; excludes free zones with own data law (Art 2(2)(g)). Organiser copies checked: "Federal Decree Law No 45 of 2021 on Personal Data Protection.pdf" is Arabic only; 2.1_PDPL_Federal_Decree-Law_45_of_2021.pdf is an unofficial English/Japanese translation with different wording (substance of Arts 2, 9, 18 matches). Art 2(1) list items appear on the portal as "2.", "b.", "c." (verbatim).
